Eight persons — A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H — were born in eight different months of the same year, from January to December, but not necessarily in the same order. No two persons were born in the same month, so four months have no birthday.

1. D was not born in a month that has 31 days.
2. More than one person was born after C.
3. Only three persons were born between D and H.
4. E was born in one of the months before May.
5. No one was born in the month immediately before the month in which B was born.
6. More than two persons were born between E and C.
7. C was born two months after B.
8. No one was born in the month immediately after the month in which H was born.
9. As many persons were born before C as after H.
10. E was born after A.
11. B was born three months after F.
12. C and G were not born in consecutive months.

questions.subject: reasoning
questions.prompt: Who was born in May?

steps: No clue fixes a position outright, so begin with the clues that limit the options most.
Now E can be in January, February, March or April (clue 4) — make 4 cases.
Case E in January: clue 10 cannot be satisfied — rejected.
Case E in March: no place is left for C — rejected.
Case E in April: no place is left for C — rejected.
Case E in February survives.
Clue 10 → A in January.
Now C can be in June, July, August, September or October (clues 2 and 6) — make 5 cases.
Case C in June: clue 11 cannot be satisfied — rejected.
Case C in July: clue 11 cannot be satisfied — rejected.
Case C in August: no place is left for H — rejected.
Case C in September: clue 8 cannot be satisfied — rejected.
Case C in October survives.
Clue 7 → B in August; Clue 11 → F in May.
D can only be in November (every other place is ruled out); G can only be in December (every other place is ruled out).
Now H can be in March or April (clues 3, 5 and 9) — make 2 cases.
Case H in April: clue 8 cannot be satisfied — rejected.
Case H in March survives.
Final arrangement: January – A, February – E, March – H, April – —, May – F, June – —, July – —, August – B, September – —, October – C, November – D, December – G.
From the final arrangement, May → **F**.

solution.trap: **G** would be in May only if clue 2 were ignored — clue 2 rules that arrangement out.

set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Month-based puzzle
set.stimulus:
Eight persons — P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W — were born in eight different months of the same year, from January to December, but not necessarily in the same order. No two persons were born in the same month, so four months have no birthday.

1. W was born in a month that has 31 days.
2. V was born in the month immediately before the month in which Q was born.
3. No one was born in the month immediately after the month in which T was born.
4. More than one person was born between S and U.
5. R was born three months after S.
6. U was not born in a month that has 31 days.
7. More than three persons were born before S.
8. Q was born three months after U.
9. Neither T nor W was born in December.
10. S and W were not born in consecutive months.
11. Only three persons were born between U and T.
12. W was born after T.
13. Only one person was born before U.
